violations.description: Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. -Observed that no Serve Safe certificate was posted, and employee was not aware of anyone certified.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Observed outside of ice machine needs to be cleaned.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. -Observed towel dispenser at hand sink was empty.
